id./param/scenario/cs/b_010_cs_050.pack|cs_: "This is Erdrea as it stands. On the day you challenged Mordegon, the world died.
"A fiery blast swept the land, burning the plants and boiling away the water.
"Blazing boulders rained from the sky, cracking mountains and shattering the earth.
"In an instant, Mordegon took countless lives.
"Despair breeds only sorrow... I saw it all, and could do nothing.
"...Somebody... Please help...
"Is... someone there?
"Help me...
"Our homes are gone, our families too. But we still have our lives. So walk! Keep walking!
"Yes, let's follow the Hero! There's a Last Bastion south of Heliodor. There we'll be protected.
"Don't give up. The Hero won't abandon us. Things will change at the Last Bastion. Live!
"Keep walking. The Last Bastion is south of Heliodor!
"Even in despair, hope remains. Somewhere in the world, I feel several flames of hope like his.
"Yet those flames are about to go out. Someone must rekindle them... and that someone is you.
"Yggdrasil, the will of the world, has fallen. Now the world is ruled by Mordegon in his citadel of evil.
"Draining the Heart of Yggdrasil was not enough for him...
"He means to pluck every life in the world and turn it into evil power... Look there.
"Those are Mordegon's servants, hunting my people of the deep.
"My barrier has hidden the undersea kingdom from his eyes. But it is at its limit.
"His power far surpasses mine.
"Soon the barrier will shatter, and monsters will swallow the kingdom."
